escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat an inherited handoff-ready.json from another issue as current delivery evidence merely because the branch contains a syntactically valid certificate.

literal_case.procedure: Compare repository, issue, PR, base and head subject against inherited certificate state before reuse.
literal_case.observed: The current package is bound to Issue 383 and PR 486 rather than inherited foreign target state.

prevention_change.description: Foreign target packages are not reused as current delivery evidence.

detection_change.description: Terminal binding is revalidated for the current issue and PR.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Generate a syntactically valid result-only certificate using a manually transcribed issue_changed_paths list that contains a typo and therefore does not equal the immutable material delta.

literal_case.procedure: Rederive the exact base-to-material changed paths and build the certificate from those canonical paths rather than copying a prior list.
literal_case.observed: The corrected certificate binds docs/database/adipometry.md and the exact eight-path material delta.

prevention_change.description: Certificate scope is rebuilt from the immutable Git compare path set.

detection_change.description: Terminal validation compares certified issue_changed_paths with the observed base-to-material delta.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat the material compatibility alias identity.head_sha as if it were the published result-only child SHA, or return audit-ready without comparing the actual published child against a fresh remote current head.

literal_case.procedure: Keep the certificate bound to the immutable material SHA, publish a direct result-only child, then obtain published_handoff_head_sha from the created Git object and compare it with a fresh current_head_sha in the terminal guard.
literal_case.observed: The terminal contract separates the material candidate from the published result-only child and requires the published child to equal the fresh remote current head before audit-ready completion.

prevention_change.description: The certificate stays material-bound and never attempts impossible commit self-reference.

detection_change.description: After publication, the terminal guard separately proves published child, current remote head, direct parent and allowlisted paths.
